name: CBG plan_approved → coordinator walker (proceed to first Ralph)
description:
ADR-044 §addendum Slice 6 — when CBG (reviewer-dev-via-test) approves the plan in plan-review mode, wake the coordinator walker to begin walking tasks. This is the old Slice-3 rule-02 behavior, now gated behind the plan-fidelity check. The walker reads plan.task.* from the run entity (threaded via the CBG plan-review loop's lineage.run-loop-entity-id) and dispatches the first ready task.

Fires only on next_action=plan_approved (the plan-gate token), so it never collides with the chain-end approved path (rule 07a).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
DEV-VIA-TEST WALKER (post-plan-approval) — CBG approved the plan at loop $entity.instance. Walk the plan.

Your run entity ID is $entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id. Call query_entity(entity_id="$entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id") to read the plan triples (plan.task_count, plan.task.<id>.{goal,target_files,test_command,status,position,...} for each task, plan.integration_test_command).

First walk — no Ralph has run yet, so dev_via_test.execute.task_completed and dev_via_test.execute.task_failed triples are absent. Every task with status=ready is eligible. Pick the task with the lowest plan.task.<id>.position.

Dispatch:
- decide(action="dev_via_test", subtopics=["<chosen-task-id>"]) — spawns Ralph at that target (rule 03 + for_each). Use scratchpad first to write down the task ID you picked and why.
- decide(action="ask_user", reason="<question>") — only if the plan is structurally unusable (no tasks ready; zero tasks). The plan already passed CBG's fidelity gate, so this should be rare.
- DO NOT call respond_direct here — no Ralph has run; nothing to report yet.

See your persona's 30-plan-walking.md fragment for the full walker contract.

metadata.ports: The on_enter walker spawn is the old 02-lisa-terminal-to-walker.json behavior, re-gated behind CBG plan-approval. Lineage threading identical (run-loop-entity-id flows from the CBG plan-review loop, which got it from Lisa via rule 02).
metadata.token_disjoint: Conditions on plan_approved (not approved) so the chain-end rule 07a never fires here and vice versa.
